look: Flat 2D digital illustration, bold black outlines, cel shading, limited warm-night palette.
style_block: STYLE (fixed for every image in this series). Medium: Flat 2D digital illustration in a bold-outline Indian cartoon and graphic-novel look, like a clean still from a modern 2D animated series. Thick, even, pure black (#111111) outlines of constant weight around every character and foreground object, about 6 pixels wide on a 941-pixel-wide image; interior detail lines (folds, facial features, seams) about half that weight; background objects outlined in thinner night-navy (#0F1528) lines so the characters stand out. Edges are clean and vector-like with slightly rounded corners: no sketchy, scratchy, hatched or pencil-textured lines. Cel shading only: every colour area is one flat base tone plus one hard-edged shadow shape, with at most one small hard-edged highlight shape; no gradients, no airbrush, no soft blending. Not anime, not chibi, not 3D, not photoreal. Characters are slightly caricatured adults built from simple readable shapes, with solid dark eyes, simple nose shapes and very expressive eyebrows and mouths. Palette: a limited warm-night palette; stay inside it, apart from the skin tones, dark wood and tiny prop details: sandy khaki (#C2A56B, shadow #8F7646), dark teal (#1F6F6B, shadow #124846), tungsten yellow (#F2B33D), pale torch yellow (#FFE08A), deep blue shadow (#1B2440), night navy (#0F1528), locker steel grey (#7C8794, shadow #4A5361), maroon (#7A2433), brass (#C9972E), off-white (#F3EAD7), and one loud accent, laddoo orange (#F28C1E), used only on the laddoo. Light (story frames): night interior, about 2 a.m., lights off in the room. Only three light sources ever exist: first, the bare tungsten bulb in the corridor behind the doorway, which gives a warm tungsten-yellow rim light on anything facing it and a hard-edged trapezoid of warm light on the cement floor; second, the beam of the yellow plastic torch, drawn as a flat hard-edged pale-yellow cone with a brighter oval where it lands; third, only when the shot description says so, the cold blue-white (#BFE4FF) glow of a phone screen. Everything no light touches is drawn as flat deep-blue and night-navy shadow shapes, never a pure black fill and never grey murk; skin in shadow becomes a darker, cooler brown and khaki in shadow becomes olive-brown. Faces, hands and the key prop of the shot always stay clearly readable. Reference sheets and prop sheets are the one exception: they are lit flat and even on a plain background. Camera: eye level or slightly below, natural perspective like a 35 to 50 mm lens; no fisheye, no extreme distortion, no tilted horizon, no depth-of-field blur. Depth comes from overlapping flat layers: a dark foreground shape, the subject, then a simpler and darker background. Composition: vertical 9:16, full bleed to all four edges, one single image of one moment. Faces and the main subject sit inside the central 75 percent of the frame; nothing important in the bottom 20 percent (subtitles are placed there later) or within 8 percent of any edge (the frame is cropped slightly for camera moves). Finish: clean flat colour, crisp edges, no film grain, no paper texture, no halftone dots, no glow blur, no lens effects.
negative_rules: STRICT RULES. No text of any kind anywhere in the image: no letters, numbers, words, signs, captions, labels, speech bubbles, subtitles, sound-effect lettering, name tags, nameplates, file labels, calendar, clock numerals or writing on paper, in Devanagari, Latin or any other script; tags, papers, ledgers and screens are blank or carry plain shapes only. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no brand mark, no user-interface overlay. No real-world police, military or government insignia, crests, badges, stars, flags or emblems of any country; no national flag, no national emblem, no portraits or framed pictures on the walls, no religious symbols. The only emblem allowed is the fictional one: a simple white hurricane lantern on a round dark-teal patch. No real or recognisable people. No guns, no weapons, no blood. No gradients, no photographic texture, no 3D rendering, no lens flare, no motion blur, no film grain, no soft-focus blur. No comic panels, borders, frames, letterbox bars, split screens or speed lines. No extra people, no duplicated characters, no extra fingers or limbs. No change to the locked wardrobe; no cap or hat on either officer.
